en: Color-tinted historical postcard showing an inner courtyard surrounded by arcaded Renaissance-style buildings. The courtyard has three stories of open arches with balustrades, a red-tiled roof with dormer windows, and a small round tower-like structure with a green domed roof on the left. There is also an ornate well in the courtyard. At the top of the image, blue printed text reads the place name and location.
